legend: The Flying Dutchman (Cape of Good Hope, sailors' legend, sighting 1881)
lines: Cape of Good Hope. Sailors whisper about a ship that never reaches port.
A Dutch captain swore to round the Cape, whatever the storm.
His crew begged him to turn back, but he laughed at the sky.
Legend says heaven cursed him to sail forever.
On stormy nights, his ghost ship rises from the waves.
Its sails are torn, and its crew stands still as statues.
Seeing it is a sign of terrible luck.
In 1881, a prince aboard a British warship wrote of a glowing red ship.
Then it faded into the dark.
Would you wave back at the Flying Dutchman?
title: The Ghost Ship That Can Never Reach Port... 👻🚢 #shorts
description:
Sailors have told of the Flying Dutchman for centuries: a cursed captain doomed to sail the seas forever. This is the legend, as people tell it.
